main.description: The chat of the livestream a video is the recording of, for a read-only replay beside it. Follows the video's connections to place.stream.livestream records of its own author (the records a recording is connected to when it is published as a video) and returns their messages oldest first, with the time the recording started so a player can show each message at the moment it was sent. Empty for a video that is not the recording of a livestream.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

livestreams.description: The livestream records the messages come from, in the order they were streamed; empty when the video is not the recording of a livestream.

startedAt.description: When the recording started: the wall-clock time of the video's first moment, so a message sent at time t belongs at offset t - startedAt into the video. Absent when livestreams is empty.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page, if any.

errors.name: VideoNotFound
errors.description: No record indexed at the supplied AT-URI.
